title: Revive
concept: Denim is one of the most wasted materials in fashion; worn, torn, and thrown away before its potential runs out. This project asks what happens if we treat it the way SPAB treats old buildings: not restored to look new, but repaired and given new life. Revive takes that same idea into denim reconstruction, working in the spirit of E.L.V. Denim’s zero-waste, hand-crafted approach to prove that discarded denim jeans have more life left in them.
